verdict_reason: The tab list and filter assertions match the three-tab book, but the wrong-case row now uses the removed 'branch' value and cannot fail, and the BRANCH rows duplicate the unknown-value rows.

todos.issue: With BRANCH gone from ADDRESS_TYPES (address-types.js) and BRANCH_ADDRESS gone from ROLES, three rows no longer prove what their titles say. ':35 an address type in the wrong case' passes 'branch', the lower case of a type that no longer exists, so a case-insensitive resolveTab would still return undefined and the row stays green: it cannot fail for the reason its title names. ':34 an address type no tab has' passes 'BRANCH', which is not an address type at all, so it is the same case as ':33 an unknown address type' under an untrue title. ':80 a role no tab offers' passes 'BRANCH_ADDRESS', which is no role, so it repeats ':79 an unknown value'.
todos.fix: Must: each row's value is a real instance of what its title names, so the wrong-case row turns red if resolveTab stops matching case exactly, and no row duplicates another. One way: use 'transporter' (or 'origin_or_consignor') for the wrong-case row, and delete the 'BRANCH' and 'BRANCH_ADDRESS' rows, or retitle them as unknown values if a removed-value regression guard is wanted.
